concept: Executive health screening; package builder and booking.

shots.title: Hero
shots.prompt: Interior photograph of a health-screening lounge with oak panels and a view of towers in DIFC, Dubai, calm, clean and welcoming, natural light, a sense of privacy and care, nobody present. Overall look: confident corporate-wellness photography, crisp daylight, 35mm; colour palette of navy, white, oak, fresh green. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.

shots.title: Consultation
shots.prompt: Editorial photograph: a physician in a white coat reviewing results on a tablet with a client in a suit. Natural light, respectful and reassuring. Every person in the picture is a clearly different individual (age, build, skin tone, hair and clothing all vary) so no face is repeated; faces may be turned away or out of frame. Overall look: confident corporate-wellness photography, crisp daylight, 35mm; colour palette of navy, white, oak, fresh green. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.
